gloss: endnote; note collected at the back of a book

definitions.gloss: endnote; note gathered at the end of a book
definitions.explanation: An annotation collected at the back of a book rather than at the foot of each page. Numbered notes in the text refer the reader to the corresponding entry in the endnote section.

examples.japanese: {巻末注|かんまつちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{出典|しゅってん}→出典：06424_shutten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{巻末注|かんまつちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめてある→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: The sources are collected in the endnotes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たどって{巻末注|かんまつちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}かれていた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: When I followed the number and looked up the endnote, I found a detailed explanation there.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{巻末|かんまつ}→巻末：21973_kanmatsu⟧ (end of a book/volume) + ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (note, annotation). Literally "a note at the end of the volume."

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{後注|こうちゅう}→後注：29712_kouchuu⟧: endnote — a near-synonym; notes placed after the text
- ⟦{脚注|きゃくちゅう}→脚注：06423_kyakuchuu⟧: footnote — a note at the foot of each page
- ⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧: annotation, commentary — the general term
